scripts.build: slidev build slides.en.md --out dist/en --base "${SLIDES_BASE:-/}en/" && slidev build slides.pt-BR.md --out dist/pt-BR --base "${SLIDES_BASE:-/}pt-BR/"
scripts.export: slidev export slides.en.md --output export/devopsdaysbsb2026-en.pdf --timeout 120000 && slidev export slides.pt-BR.md --output export/devopsdaysbsb2026-pt-BR.pdf --timeout 120000
